title: Loyi A Hlongoriweke Hi Xikambelo Xa Mati
intro: Eka tibuku ta matimu ya khale, ku na xifaniso lexi tsakisaka lexi xitori xa xona xi nga sunguriki hi singita leri hlamarisaka kumbe nhlavutelo leyi rhurhumelaka, kambe hi ndzingo wo olova kambe lowu dzikeke wa ripfumelo. Rixaka a ri yime laha ku hlanganaka tindlela, ri lava nkongomiso wa Xikwembu wa vurhangeri. Leswi humeleleke a ku ri ndzingo lowu tlhariheke swinene lerova a wu ta paluxa vapfumeri va ntiyiso exikarhi ka vona. Xana u nga paluxa xihundla lexi eka swikombiso leswi siyiweke?
clues: Ndzi huma eka rixaka leri vanhu a va ri tsakela, naswona Allah u ndzi hlawurile hi xikongomelo xo kwetsima lexi a va nga xi twisisi.
Miri wa mina a wu rhwale mfungho wa ku hlawuleka lowu van’wana a va wu pfumala, wu ndzi endla ndzi yima ndzi ri etlhelo ka vanhu va mina.
Loko nambu wu tivisiwa tanihi ndzingo, vo tala va tlhelele endzhaku—kambe ndzi tshikilele emahlweni, ndzi susumetiwa hi ripfumelo leri nga tsekatsekiki eka xitshembiso xa Allah.
A ndzi lerisiwe leswaku ndzi nga tshuki ndzi nwa ematini lama yirisiweke, hambiswiritano thonsi rin’we ri balekile emilon’wini ya mina—xidyoho lexi a xi karhata mbilu ya mina hilaha ku nga heriki.
Allah u ndzi kunguhate ku hlangana ni murisi lontsongo loyi siku rin’wana a nga ta va ntsheketo hikwalaho ko dlaya nala wa matimba.
Loko mavuthu ma lwa, a ndzi wa hi voko ra nala, kambe hi xileriso xa Xikwembu tanihi nxupulo wa ku nga yingisi ka mina enambyeni.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Talut (Sawulo) – Hosi yo Sungula ya Bani Israel
Muprofeta Dawud (David) – Hosi ya Murisi
Goliyadi (Jalut) – Xihontlovila xa Bani Israel
Muprofeta Sulayman (Solomon) – N’wini wa Moya na Jinn

identity.answer: Talut (Sawulo) – Hosi yo Sungula ya Bani Israel

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
